description: This file contains a test class 'ModuleServiceTest' that extends a base TestCase. It is designed to test the functionalities of the ModuleService class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically methods like getModuleDao, getModuleList, and updateModuleStatus. The file uses PHPUnit testing framework conventions and references fixtures for testing data.

classes.name: ModuleServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ModuleService class methods, including retrieving DAO instances, module lists, and updating module statuses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ModuleService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetModuleDao
methods.description: Tests that the getModuleDao method returns an instance of ModuleDao.

methods.name: testGetModuleList
methods.description: Tests that getModuleList returns the expected list of modules, mocking the DAO's method.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatus
methods.description: Tests that updateModuleStatus correctly updates modules, mocking DAO behavior.
